166“Bhakti is very hard to attain in two ways: by multitudes of sādhanas performed without āsaṅga, eager longing, it cannot be attained even in a very long time; and Hari does not give it quickly.” (Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, 1.1.35)

তেষাং সততযুক্তানাং ভজতাং প্রীতিপূর্ব্বকম্ ৷
দদামি বুদ্ধিযোগং তং যেন মামুপয়ান্তি তে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

teṣāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ
to them ever longing (for Me)
bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam
worshipping with love
dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ
I give understanding that
yena mām upayānti te
by which to Me come they

167“To those who are ever devoted to Me and worship Me with love, I give the understanding that brings them to Me.” (Bhagavad-gītā, 10.10)39

‘আত্মা’-শব্দে ‘ধৃতি’ কহে, — ধৈর্য্যে যেই রমে ৷
ধৈর্য্যবন্ত হঞা তবে করয় ভজনে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

‘ātmā’-śabde ‘dhṛti’ kahe, — dhairye yei rame
by the word ātmā steadfastness is meant in steadfastness who delights
dhairyavanta hañā tabe karaya bhajane
steadfast becoming then he performs worship

168The word ātmā also means steadfastness (dhṛti). One who delights in steadfastness becomes steadfast and then worships Kṛṣṇa.

‘মুনি’-শব্দে — পক্ষী, ভৃঙ্গ; ‘নির্গ্রন্থে’ — মূর্খজন ৷
কৃষ্ণকৃপায় সাধুকৃপায় দোঁহার ভজন ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

‘muni’-śabde — pakṣī, bhṛṅga; ‘nirgranthe’ — mūrkha-jana
by the word muni a bird a bumblebee by nirgrantha a foolish person
kṛṣṇa-kṛpāya sādhu-kṛpāya dom̐hāra bhajana
by Kṛṣṇa’s mercy by the sādhus’ mercy of both the worship

169The word muni also means a bird or a bumblebee, and nirgrantha a foolish person. By the mercy of Kṛṣṇa and the mercy of the sādhus, both of them worship Kṛṣṇa.

প্রায়ো বতাম্ব মুনয়ো বিহগা বনেঽস্মিন্
কৃষ্ণেক্ষিতং তদুদিতং কলবেণুগীতম্ ৷
আরুহ্য যে দ্রুমভুজান্ রুচিরপ্রবালান্
শৃণ্বন্তি মীলিতদৃশো বিগতান্যবাচঃ ॥ ১৭০ ॥

prāyo batāmba munayo vihagā vane ‘smin
almost indeed O mother sages the birds in forest this
kṛṣṇekṣitaṁ tad-uditaṁ kala-veṇu-gītam
to see Kṛṣṇa sung by Him sweet of the flute the song
āruhya ye druma-bhujān rucira-pravālān
having risen who onto the branches of the trees with lovely shoots
śṛṇvanti mīlita-dṛśo vigatānya-vācaḥ
they hear with eyes closed all other sounds silenced

170“O mother, the birds of this forest are almost sages: they rise onto the branches of the trees, lovely with fresh shoots, to see Kṛṣṇa, and with eyes closed and all other sounds silenced, they listen to the sweet song of the flute that flows from Him.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.21.14)40

এতেঽলিনস্তব যশোঽখিল-লোকতীর্থং
গায়ন্ত আদিপুরুষানুপথং ভজন্তে ৷
প্রায়ো অমী মুনিগণা ভবদীয়মুখ্যা
গূঢ়ং বনেঽপি ন জহত্যনঘাত্মদৈবম্ ॥ ১৭১ ॥

ete ‘linas tava yaśo ‘khila-loka-tīrthaṁ
these bees Your glory for all the worlds a holy place
gāyanta ādi-puruṣānupathaṁ bhajante
singing O original Person following Your path serve
prāyo amī muni-gaṇā bhavadīya-mukhyā
probably these sages Your foremost (devotees)
gūḍhaṁ vane ‘pi na jahaty anaghātma-daivam
hidden in the forest though not they leave O sinless one their own deity

171(Śrī Kṛṣṇa said to Balarāma:) “O original Person, these bees sing Your glory, which purifies all the worlds, and serve You by following You along Your path. They must be sages, the foremost of Your devotees: though You are hidden in the forest, O sinless one, they do not leave You, the Lord of their hearts.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.15.6)

সরসি সারসহংসবিহঙ্গা-
শ্চারুগীতহৃতচেতস এত্য ৷
হরিমুপাসত তে যতচিত্তা
হন্ত মীলিতদৃশো ধৃতমৌনাঃ ॥ ১৭২ ॥

sarasi sārasa-haṁsa-vihaṅgāś
in the lake cranes swans birds
cāru-gīta-hṛta-cetasa etya
by the lovely song stolen their hearts approaching
harim upāsata te yata-cittā
Hari worshipped they with minds controlled
hanta mīlita-dṛśo dhṛta-maunāḥ
ah with eyes closed keeping silence

172“The cranes, swans and other birds of the lake, their hearts stolen by His lovely song, came near and, with minds controlled — ah! — with eyes closed and keeping silence, worshipped Hari.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.35.11)

কিরাতহূনান্ধ্রপুলিন্দপুক্কশা
আভীরশুম্ভা যবনাঃ খশাদয়ঃ ৷
যেঽন্যে চ পাপা যদুপাশ্রয়াশ্রয়াঃ
শুদ্ধ্যন্তি তস্মৈ প্রভবিষ্ণবে নমঃ ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

kirāta-hūnāndhra-pulinda-pukkaśā
Kirātas Hūṇas Andhras Pulindas Pukkaśas
ābhīra-śumbhā yavanāḥ khaśādayaḥ
Ābhīras Śuhmas Yavanas Khaśas and others
ye ‘nye ca pāpā yad-upāśrayāśrayāḥ
who others and sinful of those who have taken shelter of Him taking shelter
śuddhyanti tasmai prabhaviṣṇave namaḥ
are purified to Him the all-powerful obeisance

173“The Kirātas, Hūṇas, Andhras, Pulindas, Pukkaśas, Ābhīras, Śuhmas, Yavanas, Khaśas and other tribes, and all other sinful people as well, are purified by taking shelter of those who have taken shelter of Him. Obeisance to that all-powerful Lord!” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 2.4.18)

কিম্বা ‘ধৃতি’-শব্দে নিজপূর্ণতাদি-জ্ঞান কয় ৷
দুঃখাভাবে উত্তমপ্রাপ্ত্যে মহাপূর্ণ হয় ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

kimvā ‘dhṛti’-śabde nija-pūrṇatādi-jñāna kaya
or by the word dhṛti one’s own fullness and so on awareness is meant
duḥkhābhāve uttama-prāptye mahā-pūrṇa haya
by the absence of suffering of the highest by the attainment completely full one becomes

174Or the word dhṛti means the awareness of one’s own fullness: through the absence of suffering and the attainment of the highest, one becomes completely full.41

ধৃতিঃ স্যাৎ পূর্ণতা-জ্ঞানং দুঃখাভাবোত্তমাপ্তিভিঃ ৷
অপ্রাপ্তাতীতনষ্টার্থানভিসংশোচনাদিকৃৎ ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

dhṛtiḥ syāt pūrṇatā-jñānaṁ
dhṛti is of fullness the awareness
duḥkhābhāvottamāptibhiḥ
through the absence of suffering through the attainment of the highest
aprāptātīta-naṣṭārthā-
for what is not attained past lost objects
nabhisaṁśocanādi-kṛt
absence of lamentation and so on producing

175“Dhṛti is the awareness of fullness that comes from the absence of suffering and the attainment of the highest. It frees one from lamenting over objects not attained, past or lost.” (Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, 2.4.144)

কৃষ্ণভক্ত — দুঃখহীন, বাঞ্ছান্তর-হীন ৷
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-সেবা-পূর্ণানন্দ-প্রবীণ ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

kṛṣṇa-bhakta — duḥkha-hīna, vāñchāntara-hīna
of Kṛṣṇa the devotee free from suffering free from other desires
kṛṣṇa-prema-sevā-pūrṇānanda-pravīṇa
to Kṛṣṇa in love in service in full bliss versed

176A devotee of Kṛṣṇa is free from suffering and free from other desires; he knows the full bliss of loving service to Kṛṣṇa.

মৎসেবয়া প্রতীতং তে সালোক্যাদিচতুষ্টয়ম্ ৷
নেচ্ছন্তি সেবয়া পূর্ণাঃ কুতোঽন্যৎ কালবিপ্লুতম্ ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

mat-sevayā pratītaṁ te
by My service attained they
sālokyādi-catuṣṭayam
sālokya and the rest the fourfold
necchanti sevayā pūrṇāḥ
do not desire by service fulfilled
kuto ‘nyat kāla-viplutam
how much less anything else destroyed by time

177“Fulfilled by serving Me, My devotees do not desire even the four kinds of liberation — sālokya, sārūpya, sāmīpya and sārṣṭi — that such service brings them of itself. How then would they seek worldly pleasures, or merging in Brahman? For all that is swept away by time.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 9.4.67)42

হৃষীকেশে হৃষীকাণি যস্য স্থৈর্য্যগতানি হি ৷
স এব ধৈর্য্যমাপ্নোতি সংসারে জীবচঞ্চলে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

hṛṣīkeśe hṛṣīkāṇi
in Hṛṣīkeśa the senses
yasya sthairya-gatāni hi
whose steadiness have attained indeed
sa eva dhairyam āpnoti
he alone steadfastness attains
saṁsāre jīva-cañcale
in saṁsāra where living beings are unsteady

178“In this world of birth and death (saṁsāra), where all living beings are unsteady, he alone attains steadfastness whose senses have become steady in Hṛṣīkeśa, the Lord of the senses.” (Words of the Gosvāmipāda)43

‘চ’ — অবধারণে, ইহা ‘অপি’ — সমুচ্চয়ে ৷
ধৃতিমন্ত হঞা ভজে পক্ষী-মূর্খ-চয়ে ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

‘ca’ — avadhāraṇe, ihā ‘api’ — samuccaye
ca in the sense of certainty here api in the sense of conjunction
dhṛtimanta hañā bhaje pakṣī-mūrkha-caye
steadfast becoming worship of birds of fools the multitude

179Here ca has the sense of certainty (avadhāraṇa), and api the sense of conjunction (samuccaya): birds and foolish people in great numbers become steadfast and worship Kṛṣṇa.

‘আত্মা’-শব্দে ‘বুদ্ধি’ কহে বুদ্ধিবিশেষ ৷
সামান্যবুদ্ধিযুক্ত যত জীব অশেষ ॥ ১৮০ ॥

‘ātmā’-śabde ‘buddhi’ kahe buddhi-viśeṣa
by the word ātmā intelligence is meant special intelligence
sāmānya-buddhi-yukta yata jīva aśeṣa
with ordinary intelligence endowed all living beings countless

180The word ātmā also means intelligence (buddhi), that is, special intelligence; and all the countless living beings are endowed with ordinary intelligence.

বুদ্ধ্যে রমে আত্মারাম — দুই ত’ প্রকার ৷
‘পণ্ডিত’ মুনিগণ, নির্গ্রন্থ ‘মূর্খ’ আর ॥ ১৮১ ॥

buddhye rame ātmārāma — dui ta’ prakāra
in intelligence delights ātmārāma of two indeed kinds
‘paṇḍita’ muni-gaṇa, nirgrantha ‘mūrkha’ āra
learned the sages the nirgranthas foolish and

181The ātmārāma who delights in intelligence is of two kinds: the sages, who are learned (paṇḍita), and the nirgranthas, who are foolish (mūrkha).

কৃষ্ণকৃপায় সাধুসঙ্গে রতি-বুদ্ধি পায় ৷
সব ছাড়ি’ কৃষ্ণভক্তি শুদ্ধবুদ্ধ্যে পায় ॥ ১৮২ ॥

kṛṣṇa-kṛpāya sādhu-saṅge rati-buddhi pāya
by Kṛṣṇa’s mercy in the company of sādhus attachment (rati) intelligence obtains
saba chāḍi’ kṛṣṇa-bhakti śuddha-buddhye pāya
everything giving up devotion to Kṛṣṇa with pure intelligence attains

182By Kṛṣṇa’s mercy, in the company of sādhus, one gains attachment (rati) and good intelligence. Giving up everything, with pure intelligence one attains devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

অহং সর্ব্বস্য প্রভবো মত্তঃ সর্ব্বং প্রবর্ত্ততে ৷
ইতি মত্বা ভজন্তে মাং বুধা ভাবসমন্বিতাঃ ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo
I of everything the source
mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
from Me everything proceeds
iti matvā bhajante māṁ
thus knowing worship Me
budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ
the wise with bhāva endowed

183“I am the source of everything; everything proceeds from Me. Knowing this, the wise, endowed with bhāva, worship Me.” (Bhagavad-gītā, 10.8)44

তে বৈ বিদন্ত্যতিতরন্তি চ দেবমায়াং
স্ত্রীশূদ্রহূনশবরা অপি পাপজীবাঃ ৷
যদ্যদ্ভুতক্রমপরায়ণ-শীল-শিক্ষা-
স্তির্য্যগ্ জনা অপি কিমু শ্রুতধারণা যে ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

te vai vidanty atitaranti ca deva-māyāṁ
they indeed know cross beyond and the divine māyā
strī-śūdra-hūna-śabarā api pāpa-jīvāḥ
women śūdras Hūṇas Śabaras even sinful beings
yady adbhuta-krama-parāyaṇa-śīla-śikṣās
if of Adbhuta-krama (Urukrama) of those devoted in the conduct trained
tiryag janā api kim u śruta-dhāraṇā ye
animal beings even what then holding to the Śruti those who

184“Women, śūdras, Hūṇas, Śabaras and other sinful beings — even animals and birds — come to know (the Lord) and cross beyond the divine māyā if they learn the conduct of those devoted to Adbhuta-krama, the Lord of wondrous deeds. What then to speak of those who hold to the Śruti!” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 2.7.46)

বিচার করিয়া যবে ভজে কৃষ্ণ-পায় ৷
সেই বুদ্ধি দেন তাঁরে, যাতে কৃষ্ণ পায় ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

vicāra kariyā yabe bhaje kṛṣṇa-pāya
having reflected when one worships Kṛṣṇa’s feet
sei buddhi dena tām̐re, yāte kṛṣṇa pāya
that intelligence He gives to him by which Kṛṣṇa he attains

185When, after careful reflection, one worships Kṛṣṇa’s feet, the Lord gives him the intelligence by which he attains Him.

তেষাং সততযুক্তানাং ভজতাং প্রীতিপূর্ব্বকম্ ৷
দদামি বুদ্ধিযোগং তং যেন মামুপয়ান্তি তে ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

teṣāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ
to them ever longing (for Me)
bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam
worshipping with love
dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ
I give understanding that
yena mām upayānti te
by which to Me come they

186“To those who are ever devoted to Me and worship Me with love, I give the understanding that brings them to Me.” (Bhagavad-gītā, 10.10)45

সৎসঙ্গ, কৃষ্ণসেবা, ভাগবত, নাম ৷
ব্রজে বাস, — এই পঞ্চসাধন প্রধান ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

sat-saṅga, kṛṣṇa-sevā, bhāgavata, nāma
the company of saints to Kṛṣṇa service the Bhāgavata the Name
vraje vāsa, — ei pañca sādhana pradhāna
in Vraja living these five sādhanas principal

187The company of saints, service to Kṛṣṇa, the Bhāgavata, the holy Name and living in Vraja — these five are the principal sādhanas.

এই পঞ্চ-মধ্যে এক ‘স্বল্প’ যদি হয় ৷
সুবুদ্ধি জনের হয় কৃষ্ণপ্রেমোদয় ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

ei-pañca-madhye eka ‘svalpa’ yadi haya
of these five among one slight if there is
subuddhi janera haya kṛṣṇa-premodaya
of a sensible person there comes for Kṛṣṇa of love the awakening

188If a sensible person has even the slightest connection with one of these five, love for Kṛṣṇa awakens in him.

দুরূহাদ্ভুতবীর্য্যেঽস্মিন্ শ্রদ্ধা দূরেঽস্তু পঞ্চকে ৷
যত্র স্বল্পোঽপি সম্বন্ধঃ সদ্ধিয়াং ভাবজন্মনে ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

durūhādbhuta-vīrye ‘smin
hard to grasp wondrous in power in this
śraddhā dūre ‘stu pañcake
faith far away let it be in the group of five
yatra sv-alpo ‘pi sambandhaḥ
where slight even connection
sad-dhiyāṁ bhāva-janmane
for those of good understanding for the birth of bhāva

189“The power of these five limbs is wondrous and hard to grasp. Let alone faith in them: even the slightest connection with them gives birth to bhāva in those of good understanding, who are free from offence.” (Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, Pūrva-vibhāga, Sādhana-bhakti-laharī, 238)46

উদার মহতী যাঁর সর্ব্বোত্তমা বুদ্ধি ৷
নানা কামে ভজে, তবু পায় ভক্তিসিদ্ধি ॥ ১৯০ ॥

udāra mahatī yām̐ra sarvottamā buddhi
broad great whose best of all intelligence
nānā kāme bhaje, tabu pāya bhakti-siddhi
with various desires worships still attains of bhakti perfection

190One whose intelligence is broad, great and best of all may worship with various desires, yet he still attains perfection in bhakti.

অকামঃ সর্ব্বকামো বা মোক্ষকাম উদারধীঃ ৷
তীব্রেণ ভক্তিযোগেন যজেত পুরুষং পরম্ ॥ ১৯১ ॥

akāmaḥ sarva-kāmo vā
without desire full of all desires or
mokṣa-kāma udāra-dhīḥ
desiring liberation of broad intelligence
tīvreṇa bhakti-yogena
with intense bhakti-yoga
yajeta puruṣaṁ param
should worship the Person Supreme

191“Whether he is without desire, full of every desire, or desirous of liberation, a person of broad intelligence should worship the Supreme Person with intense bhakti-yoga.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 2.3.10)47

ভক্তি-প্রভাব, — সেই কাম ছাড়াঞা ৷
কৃষ্ণপদে ভক্তি করায় গুণে আকর্ষিয়া ॥ ১৯২ ॥

bhakti-prabhāva, — sei kāma chāḍāñā
of bhakti the power those desires making one give up
kṛṣṇa-pade bhakti karāya guṇe ākarṣiyā
to Kṛṣṇa’s feet devotion makes one render by His qualities attracting

192Such is the power of bhakti: it makes one give up those desires and, attracting one by Kṛṣṇa’s qualities, makes one render devotion to His feet.

সত্যং দিশত্যর্থিতমর্থিতো নৃণাং
নৈবার্থদো যৎ পুনরর্থিতা যতঃ ৷
স্বয়ং বিধত্তে ভজতামনিচ্ছতা-
মিচ্ছা-পিধানং নিজপাদপল্লবম্ ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

satyaṁ diśaty arthitam arthito nṛṇāṁ
truly He grants what is asked when asked to men
naivārtha-do yat punar arthitā yataḥ
not indeed giver of that which again asking from which
svayaṁ vidhatte bhajatām anicchatām
Himself He grants to those who worship though not desiring
icchā-pidhānaṁ nija-pāda-pallavam
covering all desires His own feet like tender shoots

193“It is true that when men ask, the Lord grants what they ask for; but He does not give what would make them ask again. To those who worship Him, though they do not desire it, He Himself gives His own feet, tender as new shoots, which put an end to all other desires.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 5.19.26)48

‘আত্মা’-শব্দে ‘স্বভাব’ কহে, তাতে যেই রমে ৷
আত্মারাম জীব যত স্থাবর-জঙ্গমে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

‘ātmā’-śabde ‘svabhāva’ kahe, tāte yei rame
by the word ātmā nature is meant in it who delights
ātmārāma jīva yata sthāvara-jaṅgame
ātmārāmas living beings all stationary moving

194The word ātmā also means one’s nature (svabhāva), and one who delights in it is an ātmārāma. Thus all living beings, stationary and moving, are ātmārāmas.

জীবের স্বভাব — কৃষ্ণে ‘দাস’-অভিমান ৷
দেহে আত্ম-জ্ঞানে আচ্ছাদিত সেই ‘জ্ঞান’ ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

jīvera svabhāva — kṛṣṇe ‘dāsa’-abhimāna
of the jīva the nature towards Kṛṣṇa servant self-conception
dehe ātma-jñāne ācchādita sei ‘jñāna’
in the body by the notion of self covered that awareness

195The nature of the jīva is to know himself as Kṛṣṇa’s servant; that awareness becomes covered when he takes the body to be the self.49

চ-শব্দে ‘এব’, ‘অপি’-শব্দ সমুচ্চয়ে ৷
‘আত্মারামা এব’ হঞা শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজয়ে ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

ca-śabde ‘eva’, ‘api’-śabda samuccaye
by the word ca eva api the word in the sense of conjunction
‘ātmārāmā eva’ hañā śrī-kṛṣṇa bhajaye
ātmārāmas indeed being Śrī Kṛṣṇa worship

196Here ca means eva (“indeed”), and api has the sense of conjunction (samuccaya): it is precisely as ātmārāmas (ātmārāmā eva) that they worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

এই জীব — সনকাদি সব মুনিজন ৷
‘নির্গ্রন্থ’ — মূর্খ, নীচ, স্থাবর-জঙ্গম ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

ei jīva — sanakādi saba muni-jana
these jīvas Sanaka and the others all sages
‘nirgrantha’ — mūrkha, nīca, sthāvara-jaṅgama
the nirgranthas the foolish the low stationary moving

197These jīvas include all the sages (munis), Sanaka and the rest; and the nirgranthas are the foolish, the low, and all beings, stationary and moving.

ব্যাস-শুক-সনকাদির প্রসিদ্ধ ভজন ৷
‘নির্গ্রন্থ’ স্থাবরাদির শুন বিবরণ ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

vyāsa-śuka-sanakādira prasiddha bhajana
of Vyāsa of Śuka of Sanaka and the others well known the worship
‘nirgrantha’ sthāvarādira śuna vivaraṇa
of the nirgranthas of the stationary and the rest hear the account

198The worship of Vyāsa, Śuka, Sanaka and the others is well known. Now hear the account of the nirgranthas — the stationary beings and the rest.

কৃষ্ণকৃপাদি-হেতু হৈতে স্বভাব উদয় ৷
কৃষ্ণগুণাকৃষ্ট হঞা তাঁহারে ভজয় ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa-kṛpādi-hetu haite svabhāva udaya
Kṛṣṇa’s mercy and other causes from nature awakens
kṛṣṇa-guṇākṛṣṭa hañā tām̐hāre bhajaya
by Kṛṣṇa’s qualities attracted becoming Him they worship

199Through such causes as Kṛṣṇa’s mercy, their true nature (svabhāva) awakens, and, attracted by Kṛṣṇa’s qualities, they worship Him.

ধন্যেয়মদ্য ধরণী তৃণ-বীরুধস্ত্বৎ-
পাদস্পৃশো দ্রুমলতাঃ করজাভিমৃষ্টাঃ ৷
নদ্যোঽদ্রয়ঃ খগমৃগাঃ সদয়াবলোকৈ-
র্গোপ্যোঽন্তরেণ ভুজয়োরপি যৎস্পৃহা শ্রীঃ ॥ ২০০ ॥

dhanyeyam adya dharaṇī tṛṇa-vīrudhas tvat-
blessed this today the earth grasses shrubs Your
pāda-spṛśo druma-latāḥ karajābhimṛṣṭāḥ
feet touching trees creepers touched by Your fingers
nadyo ‘drayaḥ khaga-mṛgāḥ sadayāvalokair
rivers mountains birds beasts by Your merciful glances
gopyo ‘ntareṇa bhujayor api yat-spṛhā śrīḥ
the gopīs between Your arms even longed for by whom Śrī

200“Today this earth is blessed; blessed are the grasses and shrubs that touch Your feet, the trees and creepers touched by Your fingers, the rivers, mountains, birds and beasts on whom You cast Your merciful glances, and the gopīs held between Your arms — a place for which even Śrī (Lakṣmī) longs.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.15.8)

গা গোপকৈরনুবনং নয়তোরুদার-
বেণুস্বনৈঃ কলপদৈস্তনুভৃৎসু সখ্যঃ ৷
অস্পন্দনং গতিমতাং পুলকস্তরূণাং
নির্য্যোগপাশকৃতলক্ষণয়োর্বিচিত্রম্ ॥ ২০১ ॥

gā gopakair anu-vanaṁ nayator udāra-
the cows with the cowherd boys from forest to forest of the two who lead generous
veṇu-svanaiḥ kala-padais tanu-bhṛtsu sakhyaḥ
of the flute by the sounds by the sweet notes among embodied beings O friends
aspandanaṁ gatimatāṁ pulakas tarūṇāṁ
stillness of moving beings thrill of the trees
niryoga-pāśa-kṛta-lakṣaṇayor vicitram
marked by ropes and nooses of the two wondrous

201“O friends, as the two Brothers, marked by the ropes and nooses for tying the cows, lead the cows with the cowherd boys from forest to forest, the generous, sweet notes of Their flutes work wonders among embodied beings: those that move become still, and the trees thrill with ecstasy.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.21.19)

বনলতাস্তরব আত্মনি বিষ্ণুং
ব্যঞ্জয়ন্ত্য ইব পুষ্পফলাঢ়্যাঃ ৷
প্রণতভারবিটপা মধুধারাঃ
প্রেমহৃষ্টতনবো ববৃষুঃ স্ম ॥ ২০২ ॥

vana-latās tarava ātmani viṣṇuṁ
the forest creepers the trees within themselves Viṣṇu
vyañjayantya iva puṣpa-phalāḍhyāḥ
revealing as if with flowers with fruits rich
praṇata-bhāra-viṭapā madhu-dhārāḥ
bowed with the weight their branches of honey streams
prema-hṛṣṭa-tanavo vavṛṣuḥ sma
with love thrilled bodies showered indeed

202“The forest creepers and trees, rich with flowers and fruits, their branches bowed with the weight and their bodies thrilled with love, poured down streams of honey, as if revealing Viṣṇu within themselves.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.35.9)50

কিরাতহূনান্ধ্র-পুলিন্দ পুক্কশাঃ
আভীরশুম্ভা যবনাঃ খশাদয়ঃ ৷
যেঽন্যে চ পাপা যদুপাশ্রয়াশ্রয়াঃ
শুদ্ধ্যন্তি তস্মৈ প্রভবিষ্ণবে নমঃ ॥ ২০৩ ॥

kirāta-hūnāndhra-pulinda pukkaśāḥ
Kirātas Hūṇas Andhras Pulindas Pukkaśas
ābhīra-śumbhā yavanāḥ khaśādayaḥ
Ābhīras Śuhmas Yavanas Khaśas and others
ye ‘nye ca pāpā yad-upāśrayāśrayāḥ
who others and sinful of those who have taken shelter of Him taking shelter
śuddhyanti tasmai prabhaviṣṇave namaḥ
are purified to Him the all-powerful obeisance

203“The Kirātas, Hūṇas, Andhras, Pulindas, Pukkaśas, Ābhīras, Śuhmas, Yavanas, Khaśas and other tribes, and all other sinful people as well, are purified by taking shelter of those who have taken shelter of Him. Obeisance to that all-powerful Lord!” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 2.4.18)51

আগে ‘তের’ অর্থ করিলুঁ, আর ‘ছয়’ এই ৷
ঊনবিংশতি অর্থ হইল মিলি’ এই দুই ॥ ২০৪ ॥

āge ‘tera’ artha karilum̐, āra ‘chaya’ ei
before thirteen meanings I gave and six these
ūnaviṁśati artha haila mili’ ei dui
nineteen meanings there are combined these two

204Earlier I gave thirteen meanings, and now these six: together they make nineteen.52

এই ঊনিশ অর্থ করিলুঁ, আগে শুন আর ৷
‘আত্মা’-শব্দে ‘দেহ’ কহে, — চারি অর্থ তার ॥ ২০৫ ॥

ei ūniśa artha karilum̐, āge śuna āra
these nineteen meanings I have given further hear more
‘ātmā’-śabde ‘deha’ kahe, — cāri artha tāra
by the word ātmā the body is meant four meanings of it

205I have given these nineteen meanings; now hear more. The word ātmā also means the body (deha), and this gives four meanings.

দেহারামী দেহে ভজে ‘দেহোপাধি ব্রহ্ম’ ৷
সৎসঙ্গে সেহ করে কৃষ্ণের ভজন ॥ ২০৬ ॥

dehārāmī dehe bhaje ‘dehopādhi brahma’
one who delights in the body in the body worships conditioned by the body Brahman
sat-saṅge seha kare kṛṣṇera bhajana
in the company of saints he too performs of Kṛṣṇa worship

206One who delights in the body (dehārāmī) worships in the body a Brahman conditioned by the body; in the company of saints, he too comes to worship Kṛṣṇa.

উদরমুপাসতে য ঋষিবর্ত্মসু কূর্পদৃশঃ
পরিসরপদ্ধতিং হৃদয়মারুণয়ো দহরম্ ৷
তত উদগাদনন্ত তব ধাম শিরঃ পরমং
পুনরিহ যৎ সমেত্য ন পতন্তি কৃতান্তমুখে ॥ ২০৭ ॥

udaram upāsate ya ṛṣi-vartmasu kūrpa-dṛśaḥ
the belly (udara) worship those who on the paths of the ṛṣis of gross vision
parisara-paddhatiṁ hṛdayam āruṇayo daharam
from which the channels branch out the heart the Āruṇis subtle (dahara)
tata udagād ananta tava dhāma śiraḥ paramaṁ
from there rises O Ananta Your abode the head supreme
punar iha yat sametya na patanti kṛtānta-mukhe
again here which having reached not they fall of death into the mouth

207“Following the paths of the ṛṣis, those of gross vision worship Brahman in the belly (udara), while the Āruṇis worship the subtle Brahman (dahara) in the heart, from which the channels branch out. From there, O Ananta, the path rises to the head, Your supreme abode; having reached it, they no longer fall into the jaws of death in this world.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.87.18)53

দেহারামী কর্ম্মনিষ্ঠ — যাজ্ঞিকাদি জন ৷
সৎসঙ্গে ‘কর্ম্ম’ ত্যজি’ করয় ভজন ॥ ২০৮ ॥

dehārāmī karma-niṣṭha — yājñikādi jana
those who delight in the body devoted to karma performers of sacrifice and the like people
sat-saṅge ‘karma’ tyaji’ karaya bhajana
in the company of saints karma giving up perform worship

208Those who delight in the body and are devoted to karma — performers of sacrifice and the like — give up karma in the company of saints and worship Kṛṣṇa.

কর্ম্মণ্যস্মিন্ননাশ্বাসে ধূমধূম্রাত্মনাং ভবান্ ৷
আপায়য়তি গোবিন্দপাদপদ্মাসবং মধু ॥ ২০৯ ॥

karmaṇy asminn anāśvāse
in work this unreliable
dhūma-dhūmrātmanāṁ bhavān
by smoke blackened in body you
āpāyayati govinda-
give to drink of Govinda
pāda-padmāsavaṁ madhu
of the feet lotus the nectar (āsava) honeyed

209“In this sacrificial work, whose fruit is never certain, we have been blackened by the smoke; but you give us to drink the honeyed nectar (āsava) of Govinda’s lotus feet.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 1.18.12)

‘তপস্বী’ প্রভৃতি যত দেহারামী হয় ৷
সাধুসঙ্গে তপ ছাড়ি’ শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজয় ॥ ২১০ ॥

‘tapasvī’ prabhṛti yata dehārāmī haya
ascetics and the like all who delight in the body are
sādhu-saṅge tapa chāḍi’ śrī-kṛṣṇa bhajaya
in the company of sādhus austerity giving up Śrī Kṛṣṇa worship

210Ascetics (tapasvī) and the like are all dehārāmīs, those who delight in the body; in the company of sādhus they give up austerity and worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

যৎপাদসেবাভিরুচিস্তপস্বিনা-
মশেষজন্মোপচিতং মলং ধিয়ঃ ৷
সদ্যঃ ক্ষিণোত্যন্বহমেধতী সতী
যথা পদাঙ্গুষ্ঠবিনিঃসৃতা সরিৎ ॥ ২১১ ॥

yat-pāda-sevābhirucis tapasvinām
whose of the feet for the service taste of ascetics
aśeṣa-janmopacitaṁ malaṁ dhiyaḥ
in countless births accumulated the impurity of the mind
sadyaḥ kṣiṇoty anv-aham edhatī satī
at once destroys day by day increasing being
yathā padāṅguṣṭha-viniḥsṛtā sarit
as from the toe of His foot flowing the river

211“The taste for serving His feet, pure and increasing day by day, at once destroys the impurity that has gathered in the minds of ascetics through countless births, as does the river (Gaṅgā) that flows from the toe of His foot.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 4.21.31)54

দেহারামী, সর্ব্বকাম — সব আত্মারাম ৷
কৃষ্ণকৃপায় কৃষ্ণ ভজে ছাড়ি’ সব কাম ॥ ২১২ ॥

dehārāmī, sarva-kāma — saba ātmārāma
those who delight in the body full of desires all ātmārāmas
kṛṣṇa-kṛpāya kṛṣṇa bhaje chāḍi’ saba kāma
by Kṛṣṇa’s mercy Kṛṣṇa worship giving up all desires

212Those who delight in the body and are full of desires are all ātmārāmas; by Kṛṣṇa’s mercy they give up all desires and worship Kṛṣṇa.

স্থানাভিলাষী তপসি স্থিতোঽহং
ত্বাং প্রাপ্তবান্ দেবমুনীন্দ্রগুহ্যম্ ৷
কাচং বিচিন্বন্নপি দিব্যরত্নং
স্বামিন্ কৃতার্থোঽস্মি বরং ন যাচে ॥ ২১৩ ॥

sthānābhilāṣī tapasi sthito ‘haṁ
desiring a position in austerity engaged I
tvāṁ prāptavān deva-munīndra-guhyam
You have attained hidden from the gods and the best of sages
kācaṁ vicinvann api divya-ratnaṁ
glass searching for though a divine jewel
svāmin kṛtārtho ‘smi varaṁ na yāce
O Master fulfilled I am a boon not I ask

213“Desiring a high position, I engaged in austerities, and I have attained You, who are hidden even from the gods and the greatest sages. I was searching for a piece of glass and found a divine jewel. O Master, my purpose is fulfilled; I ask for no boon.” (Hari-bhakti-sudhodaya, 7.28)55

এই চারি অর্থ সহ হইল ‘তেইশ’ অর্থ ৷
আর তিন অর্থ শুন পরম সমর্থ ॥ ২১৪ ॥

ei cāri artha saha haila ‘teiśa’ artha
these four meanings together with there are twenty-three meanings
āra tina artha śuna parama samartha
further three meanings hear most cogent

214Together with these four, there are twenty-three meanings. Now hear three more meanings, all most cogent.56

চ-শব্দে ‘সমুচ্চয়ে’, আর অর্থ কয় ৷
‘আত্মারামাশ্চ মুনয়শ্চ’ কৃষ্ণেরে ভজয় ॥ ২১৫ ॥

ca-śabde ‘samuccaye’, āra artha kaya
the word ca in the sense of conjunction another meaning expresses
‘ātmārāmāś ca munayaś ca’ kṛṣṇere bhajaya
ātmārāmas and sages and Kṛṣṇa worship

215When ca has the sense of conjunction (samuccaya), the ātmārāmas and the sages (ātmārāmāś ca munayaś ca) worship Kṛṣṇa; but ca has yet another meaning.57

‘নির্গ্রন্থাঃ’ হঞা ইঁহা ‘অপি’ — নির্দ্ধারণে ৷
‘রামশ্চ কৃষ্ণশ্চ’ যথা বিহরয়ে বনে ॥ ২১৬ ॥

‘nirgranthāḥ’ hañā im̐hā ‘api’ — nirdhāraṇe
nirgranthas becoming here api in the sense of specification
‘rāmaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca’ yathā viharaye vane
Rāma and Kṛṣṇa and as roam in the forest

216“Becoming nirgranthas”: here api has the sense of specification (nirdhāraṇa), as in “rāmaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca roam in the forest.”

চ-শব্দে ‘অন্বাচয়ে’ অর্থ কহে আর ৷
‘বটো, ভিক্ষামট, গাঞ্চানয়’ যৈছে প্রকার ॥ ২১৭ ॥

ca-śabde ‘anvācaye’ artha kahe āra
the word ca in the sense of anvācaya a meaning expresses another
’baṭo, bhikṣām aṭa, gāṁ cānaya’ yaiche prakāra
O boy for alms go the cow and bring as in the manner

217The word ca gives yet another meaning in the sense of anvācaya — adding something secondary to what is principal — as in: “Baṭo, bhikṣām aṭa, gāṁ cānaya” (“O boy, go for alms, and bring the cow too”).

কৃষ্ণমননে মুনি কৃষ্ণে সর্ব্বদা ভজয় ৷
‘আত্মারামা অপি’ ভজে, — গৌণ অর্থ কয় ॥ ২১৮ ॥

kṛṣṇa-manane muni kṛṣṇe sarvadā bhajaya
in contemplation of Kṛṣṇa the sage Kṛṣṇa always worships
‘ātmārāmā api’ bhaje, — gauṇa artha kaya
ātmārāmas also worship secondary meaning it expresses

218The sage, absorbed in contemplating Kṛṣṇa, always worships Kṛṣṇa; and “the ātmārāmas also (ātmārāmā api)” worship Him — this expresses the secondary meaning.

‘চ’ এবার্থে ‘মুনয়ঃ এব’ কৃষ্ণেরে ভজয় ৷
“আত্মারামা অপি” — ‘অপি’ ‘গর্হা’-অর্থ কয় ॥ ২১৯ ॥

‘ca’ evārthe ‘munayaḥ eva’ kṛṣṇere bhajaya
ca in the sense of eva sages only Kṛṣṇa worship
“ātmārāmā api” — ‘api’ ‘garhā’-artha kaya
ātmārāmas even api of censure the meaning expresses

219If ca is taken in the sense of eva, then “only the sages (munayaḥ eva)” worship Kṛṣṇa; and in “ātmārāmā api” the word api expresses censure (garhā).58

‘নির্গ্রন্থ হঞা’ — এই দুঁহার ‘বিশেষণ’ ৷
আর অর্থ শুন, যৈছে সাধুর সঙ্গম ॥ ২২০ ॥

‘nirgrantha hañā’ — ei dum̐hāra ‘viśeṣaṇa’
nirgranthas becoming this of both a qualifier
āra artha śuna, yaiche sādhura saṅgama
another meaning hear how of the sādhu the company

220“Becoming nirgranthas” is a qualifier of both. Now hear another meaning, which shows what the company of sādhus can do.

নির্গ্রন্থ-শব্দে কহে তবে ‘ব্যাধ’, ‘নির্ধন’ ৷
সাধুসঙ্গে সেহ করে শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজন ॥ ২২১ ॥

nirgrantha-śabde kahe tabe ‘vyādha’, ‘nirdhana’
by the word nirgrantha is meant then a hunter a pauper
sādhu-saṅge seha kare śrī-kṛṣṇa bhajana
in the company of sādhus he too performs of Śrī Kṛṣṇa worship

221The word nirgrantha then means a hunter (vyādha) or a pauper (nirdhana); in the company of sādhus, he too worships Śrī Kṛṣṇa.59

‘কৃষ্ণারামাশ্চ’ এব কৃষ্ণ-মনন ৷
ব্যাধ হঞা হয় পূজ্য ভাগবতোত্তম ॥ ২২২ ॥

‘kṛṣṇārāmāś ca’ eva kṛṣṇa-manana
those who delight in Kṛṣṇa and indeed of Kṛṣṇa contemplation
vyādha hañā haya pūjya bhāgavatottama
a hunter though being becomes worshipful the best of bhāgavatas

222“Kṛṣṇārāmāś ca” — those who delight in Kṛṣṇa — means those who contemplate Kṛṣṇa. Though a hunter, such a person becomes worshipful, the best of the bhāgavatas.

এক ভক্ত-ব্যাধের কথা শুন সাবধানে ৷
যাহা হৈতে হয় সৎসঙ্গ-মহিমার জ্ঞানে ॥ ২২৩ ॥

eka bhakta-vyādhera kathā śuna sāvadhāne
of one devotee hunter the story hear attentively
yāhā haite haya sat-saṅga-mahimāra jñāne
which from comes of the company of saints of the glory knowledge

223Hear attentively the story of a hunter who became a devotee; from it one comes to know the glory of the company of saints.

এক দিন শ্রীনারদ দেখি’ নারায়ণ ৷
ত্রিবেণী স্নানে প্রয়াগ করিলা গমন ॥ ২২৪ ॥

eka dina śrī-nārada dekhi’ nārāyaṇa
one day Śrī Nārada having seen Nārāyaṇa
triveṇī snāne prayāga karilā gamana
at the Triveṇī for bathing to Prayāga made his way

224One day, after seeing Nārāyaṇa, Śrī Nārada went to Prayāga to bathe at the Triveṇī.

বনপথে দেখে মৃগ আছে ভূমে পড়ি’ ৷
বাণ-বিদ্ধ ভগ্নপাদ করে ধড়্ফড়ি ॥ ২২৫ ॥

vana-pathe dekhe mṛga āche bhūme paḍi’
on the forest path he sees a deer is on the ground fallen
bāṇa-viddha bhagna-pāda kare dhaḍ-phaḍi
pierced by an arrow with broken legs makes writhing

225On the forest path he saw a deer lying on the ground, pierced by an arrow, its legs broken, writhing in pain.

আর কতদূরে এক দেখেন শূকর ৷
তৈছে বিদ্ধ ভগ্নপাদ করে ধড়্ফড় ॥ ২২৬ ॥

āra kata-dūre eka dekhena śūkara
further a little way on a he sees boar
taiche viddha bhagna-pāda kare dhaḍ-phaḍa
likewise pierced with broken legs makes writhing

226A little farther on he saw a boar, likewise pierced, its legs broken, writhing in pain.

ঐছে এক শশক দেখে আর কতদূরে ৷
জীবের দুঃখ দেখি’ নারদ ব্যাকুল অন্তরে ॥ ২২৭ ॥

aiche eka śaśaka dekhe āra kata-dūre
likewise a rabbit he sees further a little way on
jīvera duḥkha dekhi’ nārada vyākula antare
of the creatures the suffering seeing Nārada distressed at heart

227Farther still he saw a rabbit in the same state. Seeing the suffering of these creatures, Nārada was distressed at heart.

কতদূরে দেখে ব্যাধে বৃক্ষে ওঁত হঞা ৷
মৃগ মারিবারে আছে বাণ যুড়িয়া ॥ ২২৮ ॥

kata-dūre dekhe vyādhe vṛkṣe om̐ta hañā
a little way on he sees the hunter behind a tree hidden (õta) being
mṛga māribāre āche bāṇa yuḍiyā
deer to kill he is an arrow having fitted

228Going on a little, he saw the hunter hiding behind a tree, an arrow fitted to his bow, waiting to kill deer.

শ্যামবর্ণ রক্তনেত্র মহাভয়ঙ্কর ৷
ধনুর্ব্বাণ হস্তে, — যেন যম দণ্ডধর ॥ ২২৯ ॥

śyāma-varṇa rakta-netra mahā-bhayaṅkara
dark in complexion red-eyed very fearsome
dhanur-bāṇa haste, — yena yama daṇḍa-dhara
bow and arrows in his hands as if Yama holding the rod

229He was dark in complexion, red-eyed and very fearsome; with bow and arrows in his hands, he looked like Yamarāja holding his rod of punishment.

পথ ছাড়ি’ নারদ তার নিকটে চলিল ৷
নারদে দেখি’ মৃগ সব পালাঞা গেল ॥ ২৩০ ॥

patha chāḍi’ nārada tāra nikaṭe calila
the path leaving Nārada to him near went
nārade dekhi’ mṛga saba pālāñā gela
Nārada seeing the deer all fleeing went away

230Leaving the path, Nārada went up to him, and on seeing Nārada all the deer ran away.

ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা ব্যাধ তাঁরে গালি দিতে চায় ৷
নারদ-প্রভাবে মুখে গালি নাহি আয় ॥ ২৩১ ॥

kruddha hañā vyādha tām̐re gāli dite cāya
angry becoming the hunter him abuse to give wanted
nārada-prabhāve mukhe gāli nāhi āya
by Nārada’s power to his mouth abuse did not come

231The hunter grew angry and wanted to abuse him, but by Nārada’s power no abuse would come to his lips.

গোসাঞি, প্রয়াণ-পথ ছাড়ি’ কেনে আইলা ৷
তোমা দেখি’ মোর লক্ষ্য মৃগ পলাইলা ॥ ২৩২ ॥

gosāñi, prayāṇa-patha chāḍi’ kene āilā
O Gosāñi the common road leaving why have you come
tomā dekhi’ mora lakṣya mṛga palāilā
you seeing my target the deer has fled

232“Gosāñi, why have you left the road (prayāṇa-patha) and come here? Seeing you, the deer I was aiming at has fled.”

নারদ কহে, — পথ ভুলি’ আইলাঙ পুছিতে ৷
মনে এক সংশয় হয়, তাহা খণ্ডাইতে ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

nārada kahe, — patha bhuli’ āilāṅa puchite
Nārada said the way having lost I have come to ask
mane eka saṁśaya haya, tāhā khaṇḍāite
in my mind one doubt there is it to dispel

233Nārada said, “I lost my way and have come to ask you something. There is a doubt in my mind, and I would like to dispel it.

পথে যে শূকর-মৃগ, জানি তোমার হয় ৷
ব্যাধ কহে, — যেই কহ, সেই ত’ নিশ্চয় ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

pathe ye śūkara-mṛga, jāni tomāra haya
on the path which boar deer I know yours are
vyādha kahe, — yei kaha, sei ta’ niścaya
the hunter said what you say that indeed certain

234The boar and the deer on the path — I take it they are yours?” The hunter said, “Yes, what you say is so.”

নারদ কহে, — যদি জীবে মার’ তুমি বাণ ৷
অর্দ্ধ-মারা কর কেনে, না লও পরাণ ? ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

nārada kahe, — yadi jīve māra’ tumi bāṇa
Nārada says if living beings you strike you with an arrow
ardha-mārā kara kene, nā lao parāṇa?
half-killed you make why not you take life

235Nārada said, “If you shoot living beings with your arrows, why do you leave them half-dead instead of taking their lives?”

ব্যাধ কহে, — শুন, গোসাঞি, ‘মৃগারি’ মোর নাম ৷
পিতার শিক্ষাতে আমি করি ঐছে কাম ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

vyādha kahe, — śuna, gosāñi, ‘mṛgāri’ mora nāma
the hunter says listen O Gosāñi Mṛgāri my name
pitāra śikṣāte āmi kari aiche kāma
of the father by the teaching I do such work

236The hunter replied, “Listen, Gosāñi: my name is Mṛgāri, ‘enemy of the beasts.’ I do this work just as my father taught me.

অর্দ্ধ মারা জীব যদি ধড়্ফড় করে ৷
তবে ত’ আনন্দ মোর বাড়য়ে অন্তরে ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

ardha mārā jīva yadi dhaḍ-phaḍa kare
half killed creature when writhes does
tabe ta’ ānanda mora bāḍaye antare
then indeed joy my swells in the heart

237“When a half-killed creature writhes and thrashes about, the joy in my heart swells.”

নারদ কহে, — একবস্তু মাগি তোমা-স্থানে ৷
ব্যাধ কহে, — মৃগাদি লহ, যেই তোমার মনে ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

nārada kahe, — eka-vastu māgi tomā-sthāne
Nārada says one thing I ask from you
vyādha kahe, — mṛgādi laha, yei tomāra mane
the hunter says deer and others take whichever in your mind

238Nārada said, “I ask one thing of you.” The hunter said, “Take a deer or any other animal you like.

মৃগছাল চাহ যদি, আইস মোর ঘরে ৷
যেই চাহ, তাহা দিব মৃগব্যাঘ্রাম্বরে ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

mṛga-chāla cāha yadi, āisa mora ghare
deerskin you want if come my to the house
yei cāha, tāhā diba mṛga-vyāghrāmbare
whatever you want that I will give among deer and tiger skins

239“If you want a deerskin, come to my house. I will give you whatever you want — a deerskin or a tiger skin.”

নারদ কহে, — ইহা আমি কিছু নাহি চাহি ৷
আর এক দান আমি মাগি তোমা-ঠাঞি ॥ ২৪০ ॥

nārada kahe, — ihā āmi kichu nāhi cāhi
Nārada says this I any not want
āra eka dāna āmi māgi tomā-ṭhāñi
another one gift I ask from you

240Nārada said, “I want none of these. I ask another gift of you:

কালি হৈতে তুমি যেই মৃগাদি মারিবা ৷
প্রথমেই মারিবা, অর্দ্ধ-মারা না করিবা ॥ ২৪১ ॥

kāli haite tumi yei mṛgādi māribā
tomorrow from you whichever deer and others you will kill
prathamei māribā, ardha-mārā nā karibā
at once kill half-killed not make

241“From tomorrow on, whatever animals you kill, kill them outright; do not leave them half-dead.”

ব্যাধ কহে, — কিবা দান মাগিলা আমারে ৷
অর্দ্ধ মারিলে কিবা হয়, তাহা কহ মোরে ॥ ২৪২ ॥

vyādha kahe, — kibā dāna māgilā āmāre
the hunter says what gift you asked of me
ardha mārile kibā haya, tāhā kaha more
half killing what happens that tell me

242The hunter said, “What a gift to ask of me! What harm is there in half-killing them? Tell me that.”

নারদ কহে, — অর্দ্ধ মারিলে জীব পায় ব্যথা ৷
জীবে দুঃখ দিতেছ, তোমার হইবে ঐছে অবস্থা ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

nārada kahe, — ardha mārile jīva pāya vyathā
Nārada says half killing creature gets pain
jīve duḥkha ditecha, tomāra haibe aiche avasthā
to creatures pain you are giving yours will be such plight

243Nārada said, “A half-killed creature suffers pain. You are giving pain to living beings, and the same plight will be yours.

ব্যাধ তুমি, জীব মার’ — ‘অল্প’ অপরাধ তোমার ৷
কদর্থনা দিয়া মার’ — এ পাপ ‘অপার’ ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

vyādha tumi, jīva māra’ — ‘alpa’ aparādha tomāra
hunter you creatures you kill small offence your
kadarthanā diyā māra’ — e pāpa ‘apāra’
torment giving you kill this sin boundless

244“You are a hunter and you kill animals; that is a small offence. But to torment them as you kill them is a sin without measure.

কদর্থিয়া তুমি যত মারিলা জীবেরে ৷
তারা তৈছে তোমা মারিবে জন্ম-জন্মান্তরে ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

kadarthiyā tumi yata mārilā jīvere
tormenting you as many you killed creatures
tārā taiche tomā māribe janma-janmāntare
they likewise you will kill birth after birth

245“All the creatures you have tormented to death will kill you in the same way, birth after birth.”

নারদ-সঙ্গে ব্যাধের মন পরসন্ন হইল ৷
তাঁর বাক্য শুনি’ মনে ভয় উপজিল ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

nārada-saṅge vyādhera mana parasanna haila
in the company of Nārada of the hunter mind pure became
tām̐ra vākya śuni’ mane bhaya upajila
his words hearing in the mind fear arose

246In Nārada’s company the hunter’s mind became clear, and on hearing his words he grew afraid.

ব্যাধ কহে, — বাল্য হৈতে এই আমার কর্ম্ম ৷
কেমনে তরিব আমি পামর অধম ? ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

vyādha kahe, — bālya haite ei āmāra karma
the hunter says childhood from this my work
kemane tariba āmi pāmara adhama?
how will cross over I sinful fallen

247The hunter said, “This has been my work since childhood. How can I, a sinful and fallen wretch, be delivered?

এই পাপ যায় মোর, কেমন উপায়ে ?
নিস্তার করহ মোরে, পড়োঁ তোমার পায়ে ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

ei pāpa yāya mora, kemana upāye?
this sin goes my what by means
nistāra karaha more, paḍom̐ tomāra pāye
deliverance do to me I fall your at the feet

248“By what means will this sin of mine be removed? Deliver me — I fall at your feet.”

নারদ কহে, — যদি ধর আমার বচন ৷
তবে সে করিতে পারি তোমার মোচন ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

nārada kahe, — yadi dhara āmāra vacana
Nārada says if you hold my word
tabe se karite pāri tomāra mocana
then only to do I can your release

249Nārada said, “If you accept my word, then I can set you free.”

ব্যাধ কহে, — যেই কহ, সেই ত’ করিব ৷
নারদ কহে, — ধনুক ভাঙ্গ, তবে সে কহিব ॥ ২৫০ ॥

vyādha kahe, — yei kaha, sei ta’ kariba
the hunter says whatever you say that indeed I will do
nārada kahe, — dhanuka bhāṅga, tabe se kahiba
Nārada says bow break then only I will tell

250The hunter said, “Whatever you say, I will do.” Nārada said, “Break your bow; then I will tell you.”

ব্যাধ কহে, — ধনুক ভাঙ্গিলে বাঁচিব কেমনে ?
নারদ কহে, — আমি অন্ন দিব প্রতিদিনে ॥ ২৫১ ॥

vyādha kahe, — dhanuka bhāṅgile vām̐ciba kemane?
the hunter says bow breaking I will live how
nārada kahe, — āmi anna diba prati-dine
Nārada says I food will give every day

251The hunter said, “If I break my bow, how will I live?” Nārada said, “I will give you food every day.”

ধনুক ভাঙ্গি’ ব্যাধ তাঁর চরণে পড়িল ৷
তারে উঠাঞা নারদ উপদেশ কৈল ॥ ২৫২ ॥

dhanuka bhāṅgi’ vyādha tām̐ra caraṇe paḍila
bow breaking the hunter his at the feet fell
tāre uṭhāñā nārada upadeśa kaila
him raising Nārada instruction gave

252The hunter broke his bow and fell at Nārada’s feet. Nārada raised him up and instructed him:

ঘরে গিয়া ব্রাহ্মণে দেহ’ যত আছে ধন ৷
এক এক বস্ত্র পরি’ বাহির হও দুই জন ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

ghare giyā brāhmaṇe deha’ yata āche dhana
home going to the brāhmaṇas give whatever there is wealth
eka eka vastra pari’ bāhira hao dui jana
one one cloth wearing outside go two persons

253“Go home and give the brāhmaṇas whatever wealth you have. Then leave home, both of you, each wearing a single cloth.

নদী-তীরে একখানি কুঁড়িয়া করিয়া ৷
তার আগে একপিণ্ডি তুলসী রোপিয়া ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

nadī-tīre eka-khāni kum̐ḍiyā kariyā
of a river on the bank one hut making
tāra āge eka-piṇḍi tulasī ropiyā
it in front of on a raised mound tulasī planting

254“Build a small hut on the bank of a river, and in front of it plant a tulasī on a raised mound.

তুলসী-পরিক্রমা কর, তুলসী-সেবন ৷
নিরন্তর কৃষ্ণনাম করিহ কীর্ত্তন ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

tulasī-parikramā kara, tulasī-sevana
tulasī circumambulation do tulasī service
nirantara kṛṣṇa-nāma kariha kīrtana
constantly Kṛṣṇa’s name do chanting

255“Walk around the tulasī and serve her, and chant the name of Kṛṣṇa without cease.

আমি তোমায় বহু অন্ন পাঠাইমু দিনে ৷
সেই অন্ন লবে, যত খাও দুইজনে ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

āmi tomāya bahu anna pāṭhāimu dine
I to you much food will send daily
sei anna labe, yata khāo dui-jane
that food take as much as you eat two persons

256“I will send you plenty of food every day. Take of it only as much as the two of you eat.”

তবে সেই মৃগাদি তিনে নারদ সুস্থ কৈল ৷
সুস্থ হঞা মৃগাদি তিনে ধাঞা পলাইল ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

tabe sei mṛgādi tine nārada sustha kaila
then those deer and others three Nārada healthy made
sustha hañā mṛgādi tine dhāñā palāila
healthy becoming deer and others three running fled

257Then Nārada healed the three wounded animals, and once healed they ran off and were gone.

দেখিয়া ব্যাধের মনে হৈল চমৎকার ৷
ঘরে গেল ব্যাধ, গুরুকে করি’ নমস্কার ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

dekhiyā vyādhera mane haila camatkāra
seeing of the hunter in the mind arose wonder
ghare gela vyādha, guruke kari’ namaskāra
home went the hunter to the guru making obeisance

258Seeing this, the hunter was astonished. He bowed to his guru and went home.

যথা-স্থানে নারদ গেলা, ব্যাধ ঘরে আইল ৷
নারদের উপদেশে সকল করিল ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

yathā-sthāne nārada gelā, vyādha ghare āila
to his destination Nārada went the hunter home came
nāradera upadeśe sakala karila
of Nārada by the instruction everything did

259Nārada went on his way, and the hunter went home and did everything Nārada had told him.

গ্রামে ধ্বনি হৈল, — ব্যাধ ‘বৈষ্ণব’ হইল ৷
গ্রামের লোক সব অন্ন আনিতে লাগিল ॥ ২৬০ ॥

grāme dhvani haila, — vyādha ‘vaiṣṇava’ haila
in the village word went the hunter a Vaiṣṇava became
grāmera loka saba anna ānite lāgila
of the village people all food to bring began

260Word spread through the village that the hunter had become a Vaiṣṇava, and all the villagers began to bring him food.

একদিন অন্ন আনে দশ-বিশ জনে ৷
দিনে তত লয়, যত খায় দুই জনে ॥ ২৬১ ॥

eka-dina anna āne daśa-biśa jane
in one day food bring ten or twenty persons
dine tata laya, yata khāya dui jane
daily that much he takes as much as eat two persons

261In a single day ten or twenty people would bring him food, but each day he took only as much as the two of them would eat.

একদিন নারদ কহে, — শুনহ, পর্ব্বতে ৷
আমার এক শিষ্য আছে, চলহ দেখিতে ॥ ২৬২ ॥

ekadina nārada kahe, — śunaha, parvate
one day Nārada says listen to Parvata
āmāra eka śiṣya āche, calaha dekhite
my one disciple there is let us go to see

262One day Nārada said to Parvata, “Listen, I have a disciple. Let us go and see him.”

তবে দুই ঋষি আইলা সেই ব্যাধ-স্থানে ৷
দূর হৈতে ব্যাধ পাইল গুরুর দরশনে ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

tabe dui ṛṣi āilā sei vyādha-sthāne
then two sages came that to the hunter’s place
dūra haite vyādha pāila gurura daraśane
far from the hunter obtained of the guru sight

263So the two sages came to the hunter’s place, and the hunter caught sight of his guru from afar.

আস্তে-ব্যস্তে ধাঞা আসে, পথ নাহি পায় ৷
পথের পিপীলিকা ইতি-উতি ধরে পায় ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

āste-vyaste dhāñā āse, patha nāhi pāya
hurriedly running he comes path not finds
pathera pipīlikā iti-uti dhare pāya
of the path ants here and there touch feet

264He came running in haste, yet he could find no place to step, for here and there the ants on the path were at his feet.

দণ্ডবৎ-স্থানে পিপীলিকারে দেখিয়া ৷
বস্ত্রে স্থান ঝাড়ি’ পড়ে দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

daṇḍavat-sthāne pipīlikāre dekhiyā
for prostration at the place the ants seeing
vastre sthāna jhāḍi’ paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
with the cloth the place sweeping he falls a rod becoming

265Seeing ants where he was to offer his prostration, he swept the place clear with his cloth and then fell flat like a rod.

নারদ কহে, — ব্যাধ, এই না হয় আশ্চর্য্য ৷
হরিভক্ত্যে হিংসা-শূন্য হয় সাধুবর্য্য ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

nārada kahe, — vyādha, ei nā haya āścarya
Nārada says hunter this not is a wonder
hari-bhaktye hiṁsā-śūnya haya sādhu-varya
by devotion to Hari of violence free becomes the best of saints

266Nārada said, “Hunter, this is no wonder. Through devotion to Hari a person becomes free of all violence and the best of saints.”

এতে ন হ্যদ্ভুতা ব্যাধ তবাহিংসাদয়ো গুণাঃ ৷
হরিভক্তৌ প্রবৃত্তা যে ন তে স্যুঃ পরতাপিনঃ ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

ete na hy adbhutā vyādha
these not indeed wonderful O hunter
tavāhiṁsādayo guṇāḥ
your non-violence and the other virtues
hari-bhaktau pravṛttā ye
in devotion to Hari engaged who
na te syuḥ para-tāpinaḥ
not they are causing pain to others

267“O hunter, it is no wonder that you have non-violence and these other virtues: those who are engaged in devotion to Hari never cause pain to others.” (Skanda-purāṇa)60

তবে সেই ব্যাধ দোঁহারে অঙ্গনে আনিল ৷
কুশাসন আনি’ দোঁহারে ভক্ত্যে বসাইল ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

tabe sei vyādha dom̐hāre aṅgane ānila
then that hunter the two into the courtyard brought
kuśāsana āni’ dom̐hāre bhaktye vasāila
kuśa seats bringing the two with devotion seated

268Then the hunter brought the two sages into his courtyard, fetched seats of kuśa grass and reverently seated them.

জল আনি’ ভক্ত্যে দোঁহার পাদ প্রক্ষালিল ৷
সেই জল স্ত্রী-পুরুষে পিয়া শিরে লইল ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

jala āni’ bhaktye dom̐hāra pāda prakṣālila
water bringing with devotion of the two the feet washed
sei jala strī-puruṣe piyā śire laila
that water wife and husband drinking on the head placed

269He brought water and reverently washed the feet of both, and he and his wife drank that water and placed it on their heads.

কম্প-পুলকাশ্রু হৈল কৃষ্ণনাম গাঞা ৷
ঊর্দ্ধ্ববাহু নৃত্য করে বস্ত্র উড়াঞা ॥ ২৭০ ॥

kampa-pulakāśru haila kṛṣṇa-nāma gāñā
trembling horripilation tears arose Kṛṣṇa’s name singing
ūrdhva-bāhu nṛtya kare vastra uḍāñā
arms raised dance he does cloth waving

270As he sang the name of Kṛṣṇa, he trembled, his hair stood on end and tears flowed; and he danced with arms raised, waving his cloth.

দেখিয়া ব্যাধের প্রেম পর্ব্বত-মহামুনি ৷
নারদেরে কহে, — তুমি হও স্পর্শমণি ॥ ২৭১ ॥

dekhiyā vyādhera prema parvata-mahāmuni
seeing of the hunter the love Parvata the great sage
nāradere kahe, — tumi hao sparśa-maṇi
to Nārada says you are a touchstone

271Seeing the hunter’s love, the great sage Parvata said to Nārada, “You are a touchstone!

অহো ধন্যোঽসি দেবর্ষে কৃপয়া যস্য তৎক্ষণাৎ ৷
নীচোঽপ্যুৎপুলকো লেভে লুব্ধকো রতিমচ্যুতে ॥ ২৭২ ॥

aho dhanyo ‘si devarṣe
ah blessed you are O sage among the gods
kṛpayā yasya tat-kṣaṇāt
by the mercy of whom instantly
nīco ‘py utpulako lebhe
lowly even with hair standing on end obtained
lubdhako ratim acyute
a hunter love for Acyuta

272“Ah, O sage among the gods, you are blessed! By your mercy even a lowly hunter at once attained love (rati) for Acyuta, his hair standing on end.” (Skanda-purāṇa)61

নারদ কহে, — বৈষ্ণব, তোমার অন্ন কিছু আয় ?
ব্যাধ কহে, — যারে পাঠাও, সেই দিয়া যায় ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

nārada kahe, — vaiṣṇava, tomāra anna kichu āya?
Nārada says Vaiṣṇava your food any comes
vyādha kahe, — yāre pāṭhāo, sei diyā yāya
the hunter says whom you send he giving goes

273Nārada said, “Vaiṣṇava, does any food come to you?” The hunter said, “Whoever you send brings something and leaves it.

এত অন্ন না পাঠাও, কিছু কার্য্য নাই ৷
সবে দুইজনার যোগ্য ভক্ষ্যমাত্র চাই ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

eta anna nā pāṭhāo, kichu kārya nāi
so much food not send any need there is not
sabe dui-janāra yogya bhakṣya-mātra cāi
only for two persons fitting food only we want

274“Do not send so much food; there is no need. We want only as much food as is fit for two people.”

নারদ কহে, — ঐছে রহ, তুমি ভাগ্যবান্ ৷
এত বলি’ দুইজন হইলা অন্তর্দ্ধান ॥ ২৭৫ ॥

nārada kahe, — aiche raha, tumi bhāgyavān
Nārada says thus remain you fortunate
eta bali’ dui-jana hailā antardhāna
this much saying the two became vanished

275Nārada said, “Live like this — you are fortunate.” With these words the two sages vanished.

এই ত’ কহিলুঁ তোমায় ব্যাধের আখ্যান ৷
যা শুনিলে হয় সাধুসঙ্গ-প্রভাব-জ্ঞান ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

ei ta’ kahilum̐ tomāya vyādhera ākhyāna
this indeed I told to you of the hunter the story
yā śunile haya sādhu-saṅga-prabhāva-jñāna
which hearing arises of the company of sādhus of the power knowledge

276Thus I have told you the story of the hunter. Whoever hears it comes to know the power of the company of sādhus.

এই আর তিন অর্থ গণনাতে পাইল ৷
এই দুই অর্থ মিলি’ ‘ছাব্বিশ’ অর্থ হৈল ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

ei āra tina artha gaṇanāte pāila
these further three meanings in the count were obtained
ei dui artha mili’ ‘chābbiśa’ artha haila
these two meanings combining twenty-six meanings became

277Here are three more meanings; together with the earlier ones they make twenty-six.

আর অর্থ শুন, যাহা — অর্থের ভাণ্ডার ৷
স্থূলে ‘দুই’ অর্থ, সূক্ষ্মে ‘বত্রিশ’ প্রকার ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

āra artha śuna, yāhā — arthera bhāṇḍāra
another meaning hear which of meanings a storehouse
sthūle ‘dui’ artha, sūkṣme ‘batriśa’ prakāra
broadly two meanings in finer detail thirty-two kinds

278Hear another meaning — a storehouse of meanings: broadly it is twofold, and in finer detail it is of thirty-two kinds.

‘আত্মা’-শব্দে কহে — সর্ব্ববিধ ভগবান্ ৷
এক ‘স্বয়ং ভগবান্’, আর ‘ভগবান্’-আখ্যান ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

‘ātmā’-śabde kahe — sarva-vidha bhagavān
ātmā by the word is meant of all kinds Bhagavān
eka ‘svayaṁ bhagavān’, āra ‘bhagavān’-ākhyāna
one Svayam Bhagavān others Bhagavān so named

279The word ātmā means Bhagavān in all His forms: one is Svayam Bhagavān, the Lord Himself, and the others are called Bhagavān.

তাঁতে রমে যেই, সেইসব — ‘আত্মারাম’ ৷
‘বিধিভক্ত’, ‘রাগভক্ত’, — দুইবিধ নাম ॥ ২৮০ ॥

tām̐te rame yei, sei-saba — ‘ātmārāma’
in Him delight who all they ātmārāmas
‘vidhi-bhakta’, ‘rāga-bhakta’, — dui-vidha nāma
vidhi-bhaktas rāga-bhaktas two kinds names

280All who delight in Him are ātmārāmas. They are known by two names: devotees who follow the rules (vidhi-bhakta) and devotees of spontaneous attachment (rāga-bhakta).

দুইবিধ ভক্ত হয় চারি চারি প্রকার ৷
পারিষদ, সাধনসিদ্ধ, সাধকগণ আর ॥ ২৮১ ॥

dui-vidha bhakta haya cāri cāri prakāra
two kinds devotees are four four kinds
pāriṣada, sādhana-siddha, sādhaka-gaṇa āra
eternal associates perfected by practice practitioners and

281Each of these two kinds of devotees is fourfold: the eternal associates (pārṣada), those perfected by practice (sādhana-siddha) and the practitioners (sādhaka).

জাত-অজাত-রতিভেদে সাধক দুই ভেদ ৷
বিধি-রাগ-মার্গে চারি চারি — অষ্ট ভেদ ॥ ২৮২ ॥

jāta-ajāta-rati-bhede sādhaka dui bheda
awakened unawakened rati by the difference practitioners two kinds
vidhi-rāga-mārge cāri cāri — aṣṭa bheda
vidhi rāga on the paths four four eight kinds

282The practitioners are of two kinds, according to whether rati has awakened in them or not. So on the paths of vidhi and rāga there are four and four — eight kinds.

বিধিভক্ত্যে, নিত্যসিদ্ধ পারিষদ — ‘দাস’ ৷
‘সখা’, ‘গুরু’, ‘কান্তাগণ’, — চারিবিধ প্রকাশ ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

vidhi-bhaktye, nitya-siddha pāriṣada — ‘dāsa’
in vidhi-bhakti eternally perfect associates servants
‘sakhā’, ‘guru’, ‘kāntā-gaṇa’, — cāri-vidha prakāśa
friends elders beloveds four kinds manifestation

283On the path of vidhi-bhakti, the eternally perfect associates (nitya-siddha pārṣada) appear in four kinds: servants, friends, elders and beloveds.

সাধনসিদ্ধ — দাস, সখা, গুরু, কান্তাগণ ৷
জাতরতি সাধকভক্ত — চারিবিধ জন ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

sādhana-siddha — dāsa, sakhā, guru, kāntā-gaṇa
perfected by practice servants friends elders beloveds
jāta-rati sādhaka-bhakta — cāri-vidha jana
with awakened rati practitioner-devotees four kinds persons

284Those perfected by practice are servants, friends, elders and beloveds; and the practitioners in whom rati has awakened are also of four kinds.

অজাতরতি সাধকভক্ত, — এ চারি প্রকার ৷
বিধিমার্গে ভক্তে ষোড়শ ভেদ প্রচার ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

ajāta-rati sādhaka-bhakta, — e cāri prakāra
with unawakened rati practitioner-devotees these four kinds
vidhi-mārge bhakte ṣoḍaśa bheda pracāra
on the path of vidhi among devotees sixteen kinds known

285The practitioners in whom rati has not yet awakened are of these four kinds as well. Thus on the path of vidhi there are sixteen kinds of devotees.

রাগমার্গে ঐছে ভক্তে ষোড়শ বিভেদ ৷
দুই মার্গে আত্মারামের বত্রিশ বিভেদ ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

rāga-mārge aiche bhakte ṣoḍaśa vibheda
on the path of rāga likewise among devotees sixteen kinds
dui mārge ātmārāmera batriśa vibheda
on the two paths of ātmārāmas thirty-two kinds

286On the path of rāga the devotees are likewise of sixteen kinds, so that on the two paths there are thirty-two kinds of ātmārāmas.

‘মুনি’, ‘নির্গ্রন্থ’, ‘চ’, ‘অপি’, — চারি শব্দের অর্থ ৷
যাঁহা যেই লাগে, তাহা করিয়ে সমর্থ ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

‘muni’, ‘nirgrantha’, ‘ca’, ‘api’, — cāri śabdera artha
muni nirgrantha ca api four of words meanings
yām̐hā yei lāge, tāhā kariye samartha
where which fits that I make apt

287I apply the meanings of the four words muni, nirgrantha, ca and api wherever each of them fits.

বত্রিশে ছাব্বিশে মিলি’ অষ্টপঞ্চাশ ৷
আর এক ভেদ শুন অর্থের প্রকাশ ॥ ২৮৮ ॥

batriśe chābbiśe mili’ aṣṭa-pañcāśa
thirty-two with twenty-six combining fifty-eight
āra eka bheda śuna arthera prakāśa
another one kind hear of meaning disclosure

288The thirty-two and the twenty-six together make fifty-eight. Now hear yet another way of bringing out the meaning.

ইতরেতর ‘চ’ দিয়া সমাস করিয়ে ৷
‘আটান্ন’বার আত্মারাম নাম লইয়ে ॥ ২৮৯ ॥

itaretara ‘ca’ diyā samāsa kariye
mutual (itaretara) ca adding compound I make
‘āṭānna’-bāra ātmārāma nāma laiye
fifty-eight times ātmārāma word I take

289Joining them with ca in the sense of mutual conjunction (itaretara), I take the word ātmārāma fifty-eight times:

‘আত্মারামাশ্চ আত্মারামাশ্চ’ আটান্নবার ৷
শেষে সব লোপ করি’ রাখি একবার ॥ ২৯০ ॥

‘ātmārāmāś ca ātmārāmāś ca’ āṭānna-bāra
ātmārāmas and ātmārāmas and fifty-eight times
śeṣe saba lopa kari’ rākhi eka-bāra
at the end all elision making I keep once

290“Ātmārāmāś ca ātmārāmāś ca…” — fifty-eight times. Then, dropping all the rest, I keep the word only once.

সরূপাণামেকশেষ একবিভক্তৌ,
উক্তার্থানামপ্রয়োগ ইতি ॥ ২৯১ ॥

sarūpāṇām eka-śeṣa eka-vibhaktau,
of words of the same form one remains in the same case
uktārthānām aprayoga iti
of words whose meaning is already expressed non-use thus

291“Of words of the same form in the same case only one remains (eka-śeṣa); words whose meaning has already been expressed are not used.” (Viśva-prakāśa)62

আটান্ন চ-কারের সব লোপ হয় ৷
এক আত্মারাম-শব্দে আটান্ন অর্থ কয় ॥ ২৯২ ॥

āṭānna ca-kārera saba lopa haya
fifty-eight of the word ca all elision takes place
eka ātmārāma-śabde āṭānna artha kaya
one ātmārāma in the word fifty-eight meanings expresses

292All fifty-eight occurrences of ca are elided, and the single word ātmārāma expresses fifty-eight meanings.

সরূপাণামেকশেষ এক বিভক্তৌ
উক্তার্থানামপ্রয়োগঃ ॥ ২৯৩ ॥

sarūpāṇām eka-śeṣa eka vibhaktau
of words of the same form one remains in the same case
uktārthānām aprayogaḥ
of words whose meaning is already expressed non-use

293“Of words of the same form in the same case only one remains (eka-śeṣa); words whose meaning has already been expressed are not used.” (Pāṇini)63

অশ্বত্থবৃক্ষাশ্চ বটবৃক্ষাশ্চ কপিত্থবৃক্ষাশ্চ আম্রবৃক্ষাশ্চ বৃক্ষাঃ ॥ ২৯৪ ॥

aśvattha-vṛkṣāś ca baṭa-vṛkṣāś ca
aśvattha trees and banyan trees and
kapittha-vṛkṣāś ca āmra-vṛkṣāś ca vṛkṣāḥ
kapittha trees and mango trees and trees

294“Aśvattha trees and banyan trees and kapittha trees and mango trees — trees.”

‘অস্মিন্ বনে বৃক্ষাঃ ফলন্তি’ যৈছে হয় ৷
তৈছে সব আত্মারাম কৃষ্ণে ভক্তি করয় ॥ ২৯৫ ॥

‘asmin vane vṛkṣāḥ phalanti’ yaiche haya
in this forest trees bear fruit as it is
taiche saba ātmārāma kṛṣṇe bhakti karaya
so all ātmārāmas to Kṛṣṇa devotion render

295Just as one says, “In this forest the trees bear fruit,” so all the ātmārāmas render devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

‘আত্মারামাশ্চ’ সমুচ্চয়ে কহিয়ে চ-কার ৷
‘মুনয়শ্চ’ ভক্তি করে, — এই অর্থ তার ॥ ২৯৬ ॥

‘ātmārāmāś ca’ samuccaye kahiye ca-kāra
ātmārāmas and in the sense of conjunction I take the word ca
‘munayaś ca’ bhakti kare, — ei artha tāra
munis and devotion render this meaning its

296In “ātmārāmāś ca” I take the word ca in the sense of conjunction (samuccaya), and the meaning is: “and the munis render devotion.”

‘নির্গ্রন্থা এব’ হঞা, ‘অপি’ — নির্দ্ধারণে ৷
এই ‘ঊনষষ্টি’ প্রকার অর্থ করিলুঁ ব্যাখ্যানে ॥ ২৯৭ ॥

‘nirgranthā eva’ hañā, ‘api’ — nirdhāraṇe
nirgranthas indeed becoming api in the sense of specification
ei ‘ūnaṣaṣṭi’ prakāra artha karilum̐ vyākhyāne
this fifty-ninth kind of meaning I made in the explanation

297Taking “nirgranthā eva” — “having become nirgranthas” — and api in the sense of specification (nirdhāraṇa), I have explained the fifty-ninth kind of meaning.

সর্ব্বসমুচ্চয়ে আর এক অর্থ হয় ৷
‘আত্মারামাশ্চ মুনয়শ্চ নির্গ্রন্থাশ্চ’ ভজয় ॥ ২৯৮ ॥

sarva-samuccaye āra eka artha haya
in the conjunction of all further one meaning there is
‘ātmārāmāś ca munayaś ca nirgranthāś ca’ bhajaya
ātmārāmas and munis and nirgranthas and worship

298When all are conjoined, there is one more meaning: “The ātmārāmas, the munis and the nirgranthas” all worship Kṛṣṇa.

‘অপি’-শব্দ — অবধারণে, সেই চারি বার ৷
চারিশব্দ-সঙ্গে ‘এব’ করিব উচ্চার ॥ ২৯৯ ॥

‘api’-śabda — avadhāraṇe, sei cāri bāra
api the word in the sense of certainty that four times
cāri-śabda-saṅge ‘eva’ kariba uccāra
four words with eva I will make utterance

299Taking the word api in the sense of certainty (avadhāraṇa), I will pronounce eva four times, once with each of the four words:

উরুক্রমে এব ভক্তিমেব অহৈতুকীমেব কুর্ব্বন্ত্যেব ॥ ৩০০ ॥

urukrame eva bhaktim eva
to Urukrama alone devotion alone
ahaitukīm eva kurvanty eva
causeless alone they render indeed

300“To Urukrama alone, devotion alone, causeless devotion alone — this indeed they render.”

এই ত’ কহিলুঁ শ্লোকের ‘ষষ্টি’সংখ্যক অর্থ ৷
আর এক অর্থ শুন প্রমাণে সমর্থ ॥ ৩০১ ॥

ei ta’ kahilum̐ ślokera ‘ṣaṣṭi’-saṅkhyaka artha
this indeed I told of the verse sixty in number meanings
āra eka artha śuna pramāṇe samartha
another one meaning hear by evidence supported

301Thus I have told you sixty meanings of the verse. Now hear one more meaning, well supported by evidence.

‘আত্মা’-শব্দে কহে ‘ক্ষেত্রজ্ঞ জীব’-লক্ষণ ৷
ব্রহ্মাদি কীটপর্য্যন্ত — তাঁর শক্তিতে গণন ॥ ৩০২ ॥

‘ātmā’-śabde kahe ‘kṣetra-jña jīva’-lakṣaṇa
ātmā by the word denotes kṣetrajña jīva the sense
brahmādi kīṭa-paryanta — tām̐ra śaktite gaṇana
Brahmā and others down to the insect His in the potency counted

302The word ātmā also denotes the jīva, the knower of the field (kṣetrajña). All beings, from Brahmā down to the insect, are counted as His potency.

বিষ্ণুশক্তিঃ পরা প্রোক্তা ক্ষেত্রজ্ঞাখ্যা তথাপরা ৷
অবিদ্যা-কর্ম্ম-সংজ্ঞান্যা তৃতীয়া শক্তিরিষ্যতে ॥ ৩০৩ ॥

viṣṇu-śaktiḥ parā proktā
Viṣṇu’s potency superior is declared
kṣetrajñākhyā tathā parā
called the knower of the field likewise superior
avidyā-karma-saṁjñānyā
called ignorance and karma another
tṛtīyā śaktir iṣyate
a third potency is held to be

303“The potency of Viṣṇu is declared to be superior; the potency called the knower of the field (kṣetrajña) is likewise superior; and the other, called ignorance and karma, is held to be a third potency.” (Viṣṇu Purāṇa, 6.7.61)64

ক্ষেত্রজ্ঞ আত্মা পুরুষঃ প্রধানং প্রকৃতিঃ স্ত্রিয়াম্ ॥ ৩০৪ ॥

kṣetra-jña ātmā puruṣaḥ
kṣetrajña ātmā puruṣa
pradhānaṁ prakṛtiḥ striyām
pradhāna prakṛti in the feminine

304“Kṣetrajña: ātmā, puruṣa, pradhāna and prakṛti (the last in the feminine).” (Amara-kośa)

ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে যদি সাধুসঙ্গ পায় ৷
সব ত্যজি’ তবে তিঁহো কৃষ্ণেরে ভজয় ॥ ৩০৫ ॥

bhramite bhramite yadi sādhu-saṅga pāya
wandering wandering if of a sādhu the company he finds
saba tyaji’ tabe tim̐ho kṛṣṇere bhajaya
everything giving up then he Kṛṣṇa worships

305If, after wandering and wandering, such a soul finds the company of a sādhu, he gives up everything and worships Kṛṣṇa.

ষাটি অর্থ কহিলুঁ, সব — কৃষ্ণের ভজনে ৷
সেই অর্থ হয়, এই সব উদাহরণে ॥ ৩০৬ ॥

ṣāṭi artha kahilum̐, saba — kṛṣṇera bhajane
sixty meanings I told all Kṛṣṇa’s in the worship
sei artha haya, ei saba udāharaṇe
that meaning is these all in the examples

306I have told you sixty meanings, and all of them concern the worship of Kṛṣṇa; that same meaning holds in all these examples.

‘একষষ্টি’ অর্থ এবে স্ফুরিল তোমা-সঙ্গে ৷
তোমার ভক্তি-বশে উঠে অর্থের তরঙ্গে ॥ ৩০৭ ॥

‘eka-ṣaṣṭi’ artha ebe sphurila tomā-saṅge
sixty-first meaning now came to light in your company
tomāra bhakti-vaśe uṭhe arthera taraṅge
your devotion by the power rise of meaning waves

307Now, in your company, the sixty-first meaning has come to light. By the power of your devotion, waves of meaning rise up.

অর্থ শুনি’ সনাতন বিস্মিত হঞা ৷
স্তুতি করে মহাপ্রভুর চরণে ধরিয়া ॥ ৩০৮ ॥

artha śuni’ sanātana vismita hañā
the meanings hearing Sanātana amazed becoming
stuti kare mahāprabhura caraṇe dhariyā
prayers offers of Mahāprabhu the feet clasping

308Hearing these meanings, Sanātana was amazed. Clasping Mahāprabhu’s feet, he offered prayers:

সাক্ষাৎ ঈশ্বর তুমি ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ৷
তোমার নিশ্বাসে সর্ব্ববেদ-প্রবর্ত্তন ॥ ৩০৯ ॥

sākṣāt īśvara tumi vrajendra-nandana
directly the Lord You of the king of Vraja the son
tomāra niśvāse sarva-veda-pravartana
Your by the breath of all the Vedas the coming forth

309“You are the Lord Himself, the son of the king of Vraja. All the Vedas come forth with Your breath.

তুমি — বক্তা ভাগবতের, তুমি জান অর্থ ৷
তোমা বিনা অন্য জানিতে নাহিক সমর্থ ॥ ৩১০ ॥

tumi — vaktā bhāgavatera, tumi jāna artha
You the speaker of the Bhāgavatam You know the meaning
tomā vinā anya jānite nāhika samartha
You except another to know not able

310“You are the speaker of the Bhāgavatam, and You know its meaning. No one but You is able to know it.”

প্রভু কহে, — কেনে কর আমার স্তবন ৷
ভাগবতের স্বরূপ কেনে না কর বিচারণ ? ॥ ৩১১ ॥

prabhu kahe, — kene kara āmāra stavana
the Lord says why you make My praise
bhāgavatera svarūpa kene nā kara vicāraṇa?
of the Bhāgavatam the true nature why not you make consideration

311The Lord said, “Why do you praise Me? Why do you not consider the true nature of the Bhāgavatam?

কৃষ্ণ-তুল্য ভাগবত — বিভু, সর্ব্বাশ্রয় ৷
প্রতি-শ্লোকে প্রতি-অক্ষরে নানা অর্থ কয় ॥ ৩১২ ॥

kṛṣṇa-tulya bhāgavata — vibhu, sarvāśraya
to Kṛṣṇa equal the Bhāgavatam all-pervading the shelter of all
prati-śloke prati-akṣare nānā artha kaya
in every verse in every syllable many meanings expresses

312“The Bhāgavatam is equal to Kṛṣṇa — all-pervading, the shelter of all. In every verse and every syllable it expresses many meanings.

প্রশ্নোত্তরে ভাগবতে করিয়াছে নির্দ্ধার ৷
যাঁহার শ্রবণে লোকে লাগে চমৎকার ॥ ৩১৩ ॥

praśnottare bhāgavate kariyāche nirdhāra
in questions and answers in the Bhāgavatam has made the conclusion
yām̐hāra śravaṇe loke lāge camatkāra
which at the hearing to people comes wonder

313“In the Bhāgavatam the truth is established through questions and answers, and hearing it, people are struck with wonder.

অহং বেদ্মি শুকো বেত্তি ব্যাসো বেত্তি ন বেত্তি বা ৷
ভক্ত্যা ভাগবতং গ্রাহ্যং ন বুদ্ধ্যা ন চ টীকয়া ॥ ৩১৪ ॥

ahaṁ vedmi śuko vetti
I know Śuka knows
vyāso vetti na vetti vā
Vyāsa knows not knows or
bhaktyā bhāgavataṁ grāhyaṁ
by devotion the Bhāgavatam to be grasped
na buddhyā na ca ṭīkayā
not by intellect not and by commentary

314“I know, Śuka knows, and Vyāsa may or may not know. The Bhāgavatam is to be grasped by devotion — not by the intellect, nor by commentaries.” (the words of Śrī Śiva in an ancient verse)65

ব্রূহি যোগেশ্বরে কৃষ্ণে ব্রহ্মণ্যে ধর্ম্মবর্ম্মণি ৷
স্বাং কাষ্ঠামধুনোপেতে ধর্ম্মঃ কং শরণং গতঃ ॥ ৩১৫ ॥

brūhi yogeśvare kṛṣṇe
tell to the master of yoga to Kṛṣṇa
brahmaṇye dharma-varmaṇi
devoted to the brāhmaṇas of dharma the armour
svāṁ kāṣṭhām adhunopete
to His own abode now having gone
dharmaḥ kaṁ śaraṇaṁ gataḥ
dharma to which shelter has gone

315“Tell us: now that Kṛṣṇa — the master of yoga, devoted to the brāhmaṇas, the armour of dharma — has gone to His own abode, to whom has dharma gone for shelter?” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 1.1.23)

কৃষ্ণে স্বধামোপগতে ধর্ম্মজ্ঞানাদিভিঃ সহ ৷
কলৌ নষ্টদৃশামেষ পুরাণার্কোঽধুনোদিতঃ ॥ ৩১৬ ॥

kṛṣṇe sva-dhāmopagate
Kṛṣṇa to His own abode having gone
dharma-jñānādibhiḥ saha
dharma knowledge and the rest with
kalau naṣṭa-dṛśām eṣa
in Kali for those who have lost their sight this
purāṇārko ‘dhunoditaḥ
Purāṇa-sun now has risen

316“Now that Kṛṣṇa has gone to His own abode together with dharma, knowledge and the rest, this Purāṇa has risen like the sun in the age of Kali for those who have lost their sight.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 1.3.43)

এই মত কহিলুঁ এক শ্লোকের ব্যাখ্যান ৷
বাতুলের প্রলাপ করি’ কে করে প্রমাণ ? ॥ ৩১৭ ॥

ei mata kahilum̐ eka ślokera vyākhyāna
this way I told one of the verse explanation
vātulera pralāpa kari’ ke kare pramāṇa?
of a madman raving taking who makes authority

317“In this way I have explained a single verse. Who would take a madman’s raving as authority?

আমা-হেন যেবা কেহ ‘বাতুল’ হয় ৷
এইদৃষ্টে ভাগবতের অর্থ জানয় ॥ ৩১৮ ॥

āmā-hena yebā keha ‘vātula’ haya
like Me whoever anyone a madman becomes
ei-dṛṣṭe bhāgavatera artha jānaya
with this vision of the Bhāgavatam the meaning knows

318“Only one who becomes ‘mad’ like Me comes to know the meaning of the Bhāgavatam with such vision.”

পুনঃ সনাতন কহে যুড়ি’ দুই করে ৷
প্রভু, আজ্ঞা দিলা ‘বৈষ্ণবস্মৃতি’ করিবারে ॥ ৩১৯ ॥

punaḥ sanātana kahe yuḍi’ dui kare
again Sanātana says joining two palms
prabhu, ājñā dilā ‘vaiṣṇava-smṛti’ karibāre
Lord order You gave Vaiṣṇava-smṛti to make

319Joining his palms, Sanātana spoke again: “Lord, You ordered me to compile a Vaiṣṇava-smṛti.

মুঞি — নীচ-জাতি, কিছু না জানি বিচার ৷
মো-হৈতে কৈছে হয় স্মৃতি-পরচার ॥ ৩২০ ॥

muñi — nīca-jāti, kichu nā jāni vicāra
I of low birth anything not I know reasoning
mo-haite kaiche haya smṛti-paracāra
through me how happens of the smṛti promulgation

320“I am of low birth and know nothing of reasoning. How can a smṛti be set forth through me?

সূত্র করি’ দিশা যদি করহ উপদেশ ৷
আপনে করহ যদি হৃদয়ে প্রবেশ ॥ ৩২১ ॥

sūtra kari’ diśā yadi karaha upadeśa
sūtras making direction if You give instruction
āpane karaha yadi hṛdaye praveśa
Yourself You make if in the heart entrance

321“If You instruct me, showing the direction in the form of sūtras, and if You Yourself enter my heart,

তবে তার দিশা স্ফুরে মো-নীচের হৃদয়ে ৷
ঈশ্বর তুমি, — যে করাহ, সেই সিদ্ধ হয়ে ॥ ৩২২ ॥

tabe tāra diśā sphure mo-nīcera hṛdaye
then its direction appears of lowly me in the heart
īśvara tumi, — ye karāha, sei siddha haye
the Lord You what You cause to do that accomplished becomes

322“then the way to write it will dawn in this lowly one’s heart. You are the Lord: whatever You have one do is accomplished.”

প্রভু কহে, — যে করিতে করিবা তুমি মন ৷
কৃষ্ণ সেই সেই তোমা করাবে স্ফুরণ ॥ ৩২৩ ॥

prabhu kahe, — ye karite karibā tumi mana
the Lord says what to do you will make you mind
kṛṣṇa sei sei tomā karābe sphuraṇa
Kṛṣṇa that that to you will cause revelation

323The Lord said, “Whatever you resolve to do, Kṛṣṇa will reveal it to you.

তথাপি এই সূত্রের শুন দিগ্দরশন ৷
সকারণ লিখি আদৌ গুরু আশ্রয়ণ ॥ ৩২৪ ॥

tathāpi ei sūtrera śuna dig-daraśana
still these of the sūtras hear an outline
sakāraṇa likhi ādau guru āśrayaṇa
with reasons writing first of the guru taking shelter

324“Still, hear an outline of these sūtras. First describe, with its reasons, taking shelter of a guru;

গুরুলক্ষণ, শিষ্যলক্ষণ, দোঁহার পরীক্ষণ ৷
সেব্য — ভগবান্, সর্ব্বমন্ত্র-বিচারণ ॥ ৩২৫ ॥

guru-lakṣaṇa, śiṣya-lakṣaṇa, dom̐hāra parīkṣaṇa
guru marks disciple marks of both testing
sevya — bhagavān, sarva-mantra-vicāraṇa
the object of service Bhagavān all mantras consideration

325“the marks of a guru and of a disciple, and how each tests the other; Bhagavān as the object of service; a consideration of all the mantras;

মন্ত্র-অধিকারী, মন্ত্র-সিদ্ধ্যাদি-শোধন ৷
দীক্ষা, প্রাতঃস্মৃতি-কৃত্য, শৌচ, আচমন ॥ ৩২৬ ॥

mantra-adhikārī, mantra-siddhy-ādi-śodhana
mantra qualified person mantra perfection and so on purification
dīkṣā, prātaḥ-smṛti-kṛtya, śauca, ācamana
initiation morning remembrance duties cleanliness ācamana

326“who is qualified to receive a mantra; the purification of a mantra, its perfection and the like; initiation; the morning duties of remembrance; cleanliness; ācamana;

দন্তধাবন, স্নান, সন্ধ্যাদি বন্দন ৷
গুরুসেবা, ঊর্দ্ধ্বপুণ্ড্রচক্রাদি-ধারণ ॥ ৩২৭ ॥

danta-dhāvana, snāna, sandhyādi vandana
teeth cleaning bathing sandhyā and the rest prayers
guru-sevā, ūrdhva-puṇḍra-cakrādi-dhāraṇa
guru service ūrdhva-puṇḍra cakra and the rest wearing

327“cleaning the teeth, bathing, the sandhyā and other prayers; service to the guru; wearing the ūrdhva-puṇḍra, the cakra and the other marks;

গোপীচন্দন-মালা-ধৃতি, তুলসী-আহরণ ৷
বস্ত্র-পীঠ-গৃহ-সংস্কার, কৃষ্ণ-প্রবোধন ॥ ৩২৮ ॥

gopīcandana-mālā-dhṛti, tulasī-āharaṇa
gopī-candana beads wearing tulasī gathering
vastra-pīṭha-gṛha-saṁskāra, kṛṣṇa-prabodhana
cloth seat house purification Kṛṣṇa awakening

328“wearing gopī-candana and beads; gathering tulasī; purifying the cloth, the altar and the house; awakening Kṛṣṇa;

পঞ্চ, ষোড়শ, পঞ্চাশৎ উপচারে অর্চ্চন ৷
পঞ্চকাল পূজা আরতি, কৃষ্ণের ভোজন-শয়ন ॥ ৩২৯ ॥

pañca, ṣoḍaśa, pañcāśat upacāre arcana
five sixteen fifty with articles worship
pañca-kāla pūjā ārati, kṛṣṇera bhojana-śayana
five times pūjā ārati Kṛṣṇa’s feeding laying to rest

329“worship with five, sixteen or fifty articles of offering; pūjā and ārati at the five times of day; offering Kṛṣṇa His meals and laying Him to rest;

শ্রীমূর্ত্তিলক্ষণ, আর শালগ্রামলক্ষণ ৷
কৃষ্ণক্ষেত্র-যাত্রা, কৃষ্ণমূর্ত্তি-দরশন ॥ ৩৩০ ॥

śrī-mūrti-lakṣaṇa, āra śālagrāma-lakṣaṇa
the Deity marks and śālagrāma marks
kṛṣṇa-kṣetra-yātrā, kṛṣṇa-mūrti-daraśana
Kṛṣṇa’s holy places pilgrimage Kṛṣṇa’s Deity beholding

330“the marks of the Deity and of the śālagrāma; pilgrimage to Kṛṣṇa’s holy places; beholding Kṛṣṇa’s Deity form;

নামমহিমা, নামাপরাধ দূরে বর্জ্জন ৷
বৈষ্ণবলক্ষণ, সেবাপরাধ-খণ্ডন ॥ ৩৩১ ॥

nāma-mahimā, nāmāparādha dūre varjana
the name glory offences against the name far avoiding
vaiṣṇava-lakṣaṇa, sevāparādha-khaṇḍana
Vaiṣṇava marks offences in service dispelling

331“the glory of the name and keeping far from offences against the name; the marks of a Vaiṣṇava; overcoming offences in service;

শঙ্খ-জল-গন্ধ-পুষ্প-ধূপাদি-লক্ষণ ৷
জপ, স্তুতি, পরিক্রমা, দণ্ডবৎ বন্দন ॥ ৩৩২ ॥

śaṅkha-jala-gandha-puṣpa-dhūpādi-lakṣaṇa
conch water fragrance flowers incense and the rest characteristics
japa, stuti, parikramā, daṇḍavat vandana
japa prayers circumambulation like a rod obeisance

332“the characteristics of the conch, water, fragrance, flowers, incense and the rest; japa, prayers, circumambulation and prostrate obeisances;

পুরশ্চরণ-বিধি, কৃষ্ণপ্রসাদ-ভোজন ৷
অনিবেদিত-ত্যাগ, বৈষ্ণবনিন্দাদি-বর্জ্জন ॥ ৩৩৩ ॥

puraścaraṇa-vidhi, kṛṣṇa-prasāda-bhojana
puraścaraṇa rules Kṛṣṇa’s prasāda eating
anivedita-tyāga, vaiṣṇava-nindādi-varjana
unoffered rejecting of Vaiṣṇavas blasphemy and the like avoiding

333“the rules of puraścaraṇa; honouring Kṛṣṇa’s prasāda; rejecting what has not been offered; avoiding blasphemy of Vaiṣṇavas and the like;

সাধুলক্ষণ, সাধুসঙ্গ, সাধুসেবন ৷
অসৎসঙ্গ-ত্যাগ, শ্রীভাগবত-শ্রবণ ॥ ৩৩৪ ॥

sādhu-lakṣaṇa, sādhu-saṅga, sādhu-sevana
sādhu marks sādhu company sādhu service
